The generated outputs include mathematical reasoning solutions, code completions, and system commands in response to questions.

changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to remove duplicates and use consistent capitalization. Simplified output descriptions to concise forms matching the evaluated tasks.
Removed duplicate metric names (accuracy, EM, SR, Acc) that were already represented by their full forms. Kept distinct metrics used in the paper's evaluation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper only uses automatic metrics and does not employ LLMs to evaluate generated outputs post-generation.
No human evaluation was mentioned in the paper. All evaluations were conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on domain-adaptive continual pre-training methodology (Velocitune) and evaluates it on NLG tasks including math reasoning, code generation, and system command generation. All evaluations used automatic metrics without human or LLM-as-judge assessment. The main contributions are methodological rather than introducing new NLG tasks or datasets.
